title: Digital Privacy Baseline v. Union of India
summary: Set an early constitutional baseline for privacy safeguards in government digital systems.

title: Citizen Data Access Forum v. Union of India
summary: Clarified procedural fairness and transparency duties when citizen data is collected by state systems.

title: State Surveillance Limits Association v. Union of India
summary: Introduced proportionality constraints for surveillance powers and required stronger rights safeguards.

title: Proportionality Test Refinement v. State
summary: Refined constitutional proportionality review for balancing privacy, liberty and public interest.

title: Public Interest Data Balance v. Union of India
summary: Balanced welfare governance objectives with individual privacy rights under constitutional scrutiny.

title: Algorithmic Governance Review v. Union of India
summary: Applied rights-based review to algorithmic public systems and required accountability safeguards.

title: Dignity in Digital Systems v. Union of India
summary: Connected data governance with constitutional dignity and anti-arbitrariness requirements.

title: Digital Rights Accountability Council v. Union of India
summary: Consolidated privacy, fairness and proportionality principles into a rights-accountability standard.
